title: Finance Administrative - Bilingual
description:

Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.  About us   Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable.  Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry‑first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices. With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.  We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top‑notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2000+ customers from high‑growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino’s, and the list goes on.  Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman‑founded, women‑led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it – see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, and the results speak for themselves.  From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world‑class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.  Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting‑edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.  What You Will Do   Negotiate with suppliers to get the best proposal for services or products.  Control budget requests and ensure they are accurate.  Monitor, control, and request office inventory of materials and supplies.  Register and control the entry and exit of vendors.  Control and catalog the company's fixed assets (laptops, furniture, printers, etc.).  Develop and ensure internal policies (reimbursements, travel, asset replacement, etc.).  Manage service provider contracts (cleaning, air conditioning maintenance, IT, etc.).  Request and follow up on building and corrective maintenance (cleaning, air conditioning maintenance, IT, etc.).  Update, monitor, and provide company certificates (usually requested by sales).  Control and record accounts payable and receivable.  Support the collection of overdue client payments.  Assist in the preparation of financial reports.  Organize and archive physical and digital documents.  Support audits.  Manage onboarding and offboarding of employees, including building access.  Support corporate events.    What You Will Need   Hold or are finishing a degree in Finance, Business, Management, or a related field  Are a fast learner with a proactive, dynamic, and self‑directed approach  Have up to 2 years of experience in similar roles or are a new graduate eager to learn  Are detail‑oriented and highly organized  Have a good understanding of how invoicing works, including processes through platforms like municipal systems or NetSuite  Have experience with office management and facilities  Possess advanced English proficiency (you will use it daily, and we will also have interviews in English)  Enjoy working in a multicultural environment and can communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders in a fast‑paced startup environment    What We Offer   We offer many hard and soft skills training opportunities to help you improve and challenge yourself. You’ll have access to 16,000+ online courses taught by real‑world professionals on the LinkedIn Learning platform to satisfy your hunger for knowledge.  You’ll have space to share your skills through training and workshops if you wish. Sharing is caring!  We’ll provide you with a paid Spotify account subscription, so you can cozy up in your headset cocoon whenever you want.  You’ll have a chance to work in an international, diverse, and inclusive environment.  Our working model embraces the best of both worlds with a delightful hybrid approach, where we head to the office three times a week to foster creativity, collaboration, and a vibrant team spirit.  You’ll be part of an industry that’s shaping the future of customer experiences.  Don’t believe us? Just ask Google.    R$0 - R$0 a month  We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there. To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good‑hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile. If this sounds like who you are and where you aspire to be, we are excited to meet you.  We provide equal opportunity in a zero‑discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.  Please follow Insider One on LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook and Medium!   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Diversidade, Equidade & Inclusão  Na JDE Peet's, nosso propósito é criar um futuro melhor, no qual servimos, refletimos e abraçamos todos em suas autenticidades. Acreditamos na promoção de uma organização mais diversa, equitativa e inclusiva, em que todos se sintam confortáveis para serem, verdadeiramente, quem são e possam despertar todo o seu potencial. Isto significa que não toleramos qualquer tipo de discriminação com base em raça ou etnia, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica diversa e protegida por lei.  Ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos associados, priorizamos DE&I no centro dos nossos processos de pessoas. Isso nos permite promover o respeito e eliminar qualquer preconceito ou ação discriminatória, garantindo uma experiência inclusiva no ambiente de trabalho. Não hesite em entrar em contato se precisar de qualquer suporte durante o processo de recrutamento.  Nossos esforços nessa agenda nos renderam o prestigioso Prêmio Catalyst e a Certificação Fair Pay Leader 2025, reconhecimento pelo nosso compromisso com a equidade salarial, refletido em uma diferença de gênero global de apenas 0,52%.  #DesperteSuasPossibilidades #UmaXícaradeMomentosIncríveis  Descrição da empresa  Quem somos nós?   Somos a JDE Peet’s. Nós produzimos um café para cada xícara e desenvolvemos marcas para cada coração.  A JDE Peet’s é a principal empresa global dedicada exclusivamente ao café, servindo aproximadamente 4.400 xícaras de café por segundo em mais de 100 mercados. Guiados pela nossa estratégia “Reviver o Incrível”, focamos em um crescimento liderado por marcas com três grandes apostas: Peet’s, L’OR e Jacobs, além de um portfólio de 9 ícones locais, como Douwe Egberts, Kenco, Pilão, Old Town, Moccona, Super, Gevalia, Friele e Marcilla.  No Brasil, somos uma das maiores empresas de café e temos atuação nacional através de nossas marcas Pilão, L’OR, Café do Ponto, Damasco, Café Maratá, Caboclo, Café Pelé, Café Puro, Chá Maratá e Chá Castelari.  Como é trabalhar na JDE Peet's?   Somos pessoas unidas pelas possibilidades de café e chá. Na JDE Peet's, nós nos desenvolvemos com a liberdade de buscar oportunidades e de provocar novas ideias para causar um impacto positivo no mundo do café e do chá.  Nossa ambição é simples: despertar possibilidades de café e chá. Colocamos em prática nossas intenções, cumprindo o que foi acordado e sempre levando as coisas adiante. Oferecemos aos nossos associados uma série de programas de aprendizado e desenvolvimento para apoiar seu crescimento pessoal.  Na JDE Peet's, acreditamos que é incrível o que acontece ao redor de uma xícara de café ou chá.  Inscreva-se para experimentar uma xícara de momentos incríveis em sua carreira. title: HR Manager
description:
Nova oportunidade para HR Manager em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

As the HR Manager you will be responsible for leading and managing all people‑related programs and processes that support the organization's business goals and team experience. This is a senior role that leads hiring, onboarding, employee relations, performance systems, compensation strategy, and compliance, with a strong emphasis on U.S. employment practices. The position combines long‑term people strategy with hands‑on implementation and is suited to someone who has extensive U.S. HR experience and enjoys building systems in a dynamic environment while balancing empathy with operational rigor.  Key Responsibilities  Talent acquisition   Own senior‑level and critical hiring processes, including role definition, postings, sourcing strategy, screening, and offer coordination.  Partner with department leaders to define competencies, scorecards, and structured interview processes for U.S.-based and global roles.  Build and maintain a strong pipeline of experienced candidates across coaching, marketing, operations, and leadership functions.  Support efforts to attract diverse talent that aligns with the organization's mission and values, with particular attention to U.S. labor market dynamics.  Collaborate, when needed, with pre‑approved external recruiting partners to support specialized or hard‑to‑fill searches.    Onboarding and employee experience   Lead the design and execution of a structured onboarding experience for U.S. and international hires, ensuring clarity on expectations, tools, and culture.  Continuously refine the new‑hire journey to reflect the organization's brand, values, and distributed, often remote, workforce.  Partner with leaders to foster strong cross‑functional communication and collaboration across time zones and locations.  Support and help design engagement initiatives, team development activities, and culture‑building practices.    Compensation, benefits, and HR operations   Oversee HR operations for U.S. employees, including payroll changes, employee records, and HR platforms, with a focus on accuracy and confidentiality.  Partner with leadership to develop and refine compensation strategies, conduct U.S. market benchmarking, and build transparent salary bands.  Manage PTO/FTO tracking, leave administration, and compliance with multi‑state U.S. employment requirements, while also considering international contexts where applicable.  Maintain and improve HR systems, documentation, and SOPs that support scale and clarity.    Performance management and development   Lead the design and facilitation of 360 reviews, performance cycles, and goal‑setting frameworks.  Coach leaders on addressing performance gaps, and support the creation of development plans and performance improvement plans where needed.  Help define and refine career paths across coaching and operational teams, with clear expectations and progression criteria.  Promote a culture of accountability, feedback, and clear ownership across the organization.    Employee relations   Serve as a senior, neutral point of contact for employees and leaders navigating complex concerns, feedback, or interpersonal issues, particularly in U.S. contexts.  Manage sensitive issues with discretion, consistency, and fairness, balancing individual needs and organizational priorities.  Advise leadership on communication approaches, change management, and practices that reduce friction and misalignment.    Compliance and risk management   Ensure HR practices align with applicable federal, state, and local U.S. employment regulations, and coordinate on international compliance as needed.  Own the ongoing maintenance of employee handbooks, policies, and documentation, ensuring alignment with legal requirements and organizational values.  Lead and document investigations, corrective actions, and HR‑related risk mitigation with professionalism and attention to detail.    Organizational development and scaling   Design and refine scalable HR processes that support continued growth, including in the U.S. and global markets.  Provide people‑related insights and data to inform decisions about structure, headcount planning, and cultural impact.    Requirements   7+ years of progressive experience in Human Resources, People Operations, or a similar field, with substantial U.S.-based experience.  Background in high‑growth, entrepreneurial, or service‑based organizations.  Deep understanding of U.S. employment law, including multi‑state compliance; international HR experience is a plus.  Demonstrated track record of building and scaling HR processes and programs from the ground up.  Strong communication, facilitation, active listening, and conflict‑resolution skills, including with senior stakeholders.  High level of confidentiality, integrity, and emotional intelligence.  Ability to balance empathy with accountability, clear expectations, and data‑informed decision‑making.  Proficiency with HRIS systems and modern project management tools; experience with Asana or similar platforms is preferred.    Benefits   Salary: $3,500 - $4,500 USD/month  Flexible time off + Holidays    Seniority level   Mid‑Senior level    Employment type   Full‑time    Job function   Other  Industries: IT Services and IT Consulting     #J-18808-Ljbffr

Analista Pleno de Inventário, Qualidade e Prevenção de Perdas - Mercado Envios Join to apply for the Analista Pleno de Inventário, Qualidade e Prevenção de Perdas - Mercado Envios  role at Mercado Livre Brasil  Analista Pleno de Inventário, Qualidade e Prevenção de Perdas - Mercado Envios Join to apply for the Analista Pleno de Inventário, Qualidade e Prevenção de Perdas - Mercado Envios  role at Mercado Livre Brasil  No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito! No Mercado Envios administramos o estoque de nossos vendedores e entregamos os produtos aos nossos compradores, melhorando sua experiência em nossa plataforma. Em um mundo em constante evolução, nossa capacidade para entregar rapidamente os produtos que são comprados através do Mercado Livre tornou-se um requisito para competir. Faça parte da equipe que está liderando a logística na América Latina, oferecendo soluções customizadas de classe mundial e integrando carriers locais e regionais, através de um comércio que não reconhece fronteiras. Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:  Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites. Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação. Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros. A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas. Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão. Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.  Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:  Desenvolver, controlar, analisar e correlacionar os principais indicadores de desempenho das áreas de Inventário e Qualidade e Prevenção de Perdas. Identificar e propor oportunidades de melhorias para a performance e os processos. Controlar a configuração de ocupação das áreas de estoque, monitorando diariamente a sua variação através de um mapa de calor com atualização no devido tempo para controle da movimentação dos itens no fluxo de entrada e de saída. Desenvolver fluxos de qualidade junto com as operações, garantindo a elaboração de documentação e a capacitação das equipes internas e externas. Implementar indicadores e dashboards de qualidade, e ter uma visão analítica para a identificação dos desvios e das principais oportunidades. Apoiar as auditorias de qualidade de processos e produtos em todas as operações do centro de distribuição.  Requisitos:  Possuir formação superior completa em Administração de Empresas, Engenharia, Logística ou áreas correlatas. Contar com experiência com o pacote Office ou as ferramentas do Google e conhecimentos sobre SQL, Python e Data Studio. Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial é um diferencial. Possuir experiência prévia nas áreas de qualidade, inventário e operações. E conhecimento em normas de qualidade e metodologias de melhoria contínua. Ter disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente em Cravinhos/SP, no horário das 09h00 às 18h48, de segunda a sexta.  Nós lhe propomos:  Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo. Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores. Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas. Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência.  O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie! A sustentabilidade nos guia, a tecnologia nos capacita, mas é a paixão e a motivação de nossa gente que realmente nos inspira a entregar o melhor. title: Human Resources Director Brazil
description:
Confira a vaga para Human Resources Director Brazil em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

At Diaverum , we are looking for a business-oriented and hands-on HR Director  to lead our HR function in Brazil. This role is critical in attracting, developing, and retaining top talent  while ensuring a positive, inclusive, and compliant  work environment. Everyone deserves a fulfilling life. That’s why we’re dedicated to enhancing the lives of renal patients.  As a global leader and the largest independent renal service provider in Europe, we have 13,000 healthcare professionals caring for around 41,000 patients across 450 clinics in 24 countries globally . We provide renal care personalized to patients’ needs and choices, offering a portfolio of treatments ranging from preventive care, hemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis and home care, to the coordination of patients’ comorbidities and holiday dialysis. Our vision is to transform renal care, delivering and broadening access to the highest quality of kidney care for patients around the world . At the heart of what we do is our standardized care delivery model, continuously evolving digital & AI infrastructure and people caring for patients with competence, passion and inspiration.  Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden, Diaverum is part of the M42 group of companies , a first-of-its-kind integrated health powerhouse committed to the sustainable future of health. Diaverum Brazil ranks first in the number of patients within the Diaverum group and is the second-largest player in the Brazilian market. The company provides renal services through its own clinics and as a third-party provider for hospitals, treating 4,500 chronic patients across 12 clinics, performing 75,000 treatments per month. Headquartered in São Paulo, its clinics are located in the São Paulo metropolitan region and the state of Sergipe, while also serving hospitals in São Paulo, Sergipe, Bahia, and João Pessoa. Diaverum Brazil has a team of 1,200 direct employees and 200 contracted nephrologists. The HR team consists of 16 members, with two based at the headquarters and the rest distributed across the clinics. With an average business growth of over 30% per year, the company is currently developing and deploying HR IT systems in a dynamic, flexible, and multidisciplinary environment. As a key member of the Management Team , you will play a pivotal role in driving the HR strategy, talent development, employee relations, and compliance with local labour laws , ensuring alignment with global HR standards  and company goals. Reporting to the Country Manager Brazil, this role is based in São Paulo (headquarters in the Vila Olímpia neighborhood) and requires between 20% and 40% local travel. Develop and implement a business-driven HR strategy , supporting the organizational structure with leadership. Act as an ambassador and change agent , ensuring that Diaverum’s culture and values  are a living reality. Represent HR in the Country Management Team  and Brazil in the global HR team , contributing to continuous improvement projects. Be a visible and hands-on  partner for senior leaders, managers, and employees. Ensure labour law compliance  and provide guidance on employment matters. Equip clinic managers with HR tools  to become strong “people managers.” Support in talent acquisition, performance management, compensation, and development . Oversee payroll, contracts, and HR administration . Manage the full employee lifecycle , including recruitment, onboarding, engagement, and performance reviews. Support M&A activities , ensuring a seamless HR operational transition . Lead workforce planning , ensuring talent attraction and retention. Contribute to budget planning  and labour efficiency initiatives  with Finance and Operations. Measure and report on key HR data  to drive decision-making. Develop and implement HR policies and procedures  aligned with corporate standards. Ensure HR tools are available and used effectively across the business. Educate managers and employees on HR processes, including creating employee handbooks and onboarding materials.  People & Organizational Development  Lead organizational design initiatives with the management team. Drive learning & development, ensuring training programs support business needs. Oversee employee onboarding, ensuring a strong integration into Diaverum’s culture and values. Lead succession planning for key management roles and specialists. Implement the annual performance appraisal process, ensuring clear goal setting and development plans. Support restructuring initiatives to optimize the organization’s effectiveness. Oversee payroll and benefits administration , ensuring compliance and efficiency. Implement a structured annual compensation review process  based on market benchmarks and performance. Develop compensation strategies  that drive a high-performance culture .  ABOUT YOU  You have 8-10 years of experience  in HR across multiple disciplines and a proven track record  in leading change within multilevel organizations . Your strong business acumen  allows you to align HR strategies with company goals, and you have an in-depth understanding of Brazilian labour law . You have worked in an international environment , and if you have experience in the healthcare industry , that’s a big plus. You hold a university degree in HR, Finance, or a related field , and you are fluent in English . You are comfortable using MS Office  and other HR tools to support business operations. You are a customer-focused HR leader  with strong relationship-building skills. You take a hands-on approach , ensuring HR strategies are not only well-designed but also effectively executed. Your communication, listening, and coaching skills  allow you to support both employees and managers, creating a positive and productive work environment. As a change agent , you have the ability to lead HR transformations and integration processes, making a real impact on the business. title: DESENVOLVEDOR FRONT-END PLENO
description:

O objetivo da nossa solução é transformar a indústria, tornando-a mais segura e mais produtiva que ontem. Ao produzirmos os hardwares e softwares da nossa solução, buscamos apresentar aos nossos clientes e parceiros o porquê de sermos referência em soluções eficientes e eficazes para monitoramento, manutenção e performance de ativos.  Além disso, temos orgulho em possuir as certificações das ISOs 9001, 27001, 27018, 27701. Por meio delas, promovemos a organização e a estrutura de nossos processos, resultando em um ambiente de trabalho mais organizado e eficiente, através de uma cultura interna onde os funcionários são incentivados a buscar a excelência em suas atividades, com oportunidades regulares de aprendizado e desenvolvimento profissional.  Conheça mais sobre nós, visite nosso site.  Sobre a equipe na qual você irá atuar  Você fará parte de uma equipe multidisciplinar dedicada ao desenvolvimento de soluções voltadas para manutenção preditiva de ativos industriais, com foco em ferramentas de análise de vibração e diagnóstico de falhas apoiado por inteligência artificial.  Nossa missão é gerar valor para inspetores e analistas por meio de tecnologias que combinam processamento de sinais, modelos de IA e interfaces intuitivas. A equipe é composta por desenvolvedores front-end e back-end, profissionais de QA, gerentes de produto e designers, todos comprometidos com a entrega de uma experiência de usuário eficiente, confiável e impactante. Interpretar protótipos gráficos e wireframes, trabalhando em conjunto com designers e gerentes de produto para transformar interfaces em experiências funcionais e acessíveis.  Integrar aplicações front-end a APIs e sistemas externos, assegurando comunicação eficiente entre os componentes da plataforma.  Participar de práticas colaborativas, como pair programming, code reviews e discussões técnicas, contribuindo para a evolução contínua do produto e da equipe.  Gerenciar suas próprias tarefas, atuando com autonomia e responsabilidade dentro de um ambiente ágil e multidisciplinar.  Aplicar e disseminar boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software, incluindo padrões de projeto, testes automatizados e versionamento de código.  Contribuir para a segurança da informação e privacidade de dados, adotando práticas seguras no desenvolvimento e no uso de dados sensíveis.    Requisitos   Experiência com JavaScript, React, HTML e CSS para desenvolvimento de aplicações web.  Conhecimento em ferramentas modernas de desenvolvimento front-end como Vite ou Webpack.  Familiaridade com Git para versionamento de código e trabalho colaborativo.  Familiaridade com ferramentas como Figma para consultar especificações de layout e estilo de interfaces.  Disposição para evolução constante e aprendizado de novas tecnologias.    Desejáveis   Experiência com TypeScript em projetos React.  Experiência com bibliotecas de componentes UI como Material UI e Styled Components.  Familiaridade com bibliotecas de gerenciamento de estado, como React Context, Redux ou similares.  Experiência com testes automatizados utilizando ferramentas como Vitest ou Jest.  Conhecimento em bibliotecas de visualização de dados como D3, Highcharts, Plotly ou similares.  Noções de deploy de aplicações front-end em ambientes de nuvem, como Vercel, AWS ou Google Cloud.  Familiaridade com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento, como Sentry, New Relic, Datadog ou similares.  Experiência com CI/CD pipelines, especialmente em ambientes que utilizam GitHub Actions, GitLab CI ou similares. title: Data & AI Consultant São Paulo Early Career
description:
Empresa está contratando Data & AI Consultant São Paulo Early Career em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Thorogood is an independent, specialized, data and AI consulting firm that works with some of the biggest and best-known companies around the world. We have offices in London, Philadelphia, Boston, Singapore, São Paulo, and Bangalore, and we work as a global unit to service blue chip customers drawing from the consumer goods, pharmaceutical, and financial services sectors, among others. Together, we compete on the basis of our specialism, our people, high quality, and assured delivery. We help our customers leverage the latest technologies to make timely, data-driven business decisions. Our multi-skilled teams understand the critical interplay of data engineering, data science, and data visualization. We work across these areas to create business-focused, end-to-end technology solutions robust enough to meet enterprise needs. We recognize the importance of environmental sustainability, both in how we work and in the solutions we build for our clients. Our services span strategy, implementation, advanced analytics services, user empowerment, and support. Additional information about us, our people, what we do, and some of perspectives can be found on our website here:  About the Position Overview Our consultants are expected to have a strong interest in business. Understanding our clients’ organizations and industries is key to identifying areas of opportunity for us to help. Similarly, consultants must have excellent listening, writing, and presenting skills, alongside the aptitude and motivation to master multiple data-focused technologies in a fast-moving field. This combination of business, people, and technical skills is essential. Our Brazil and US entities are managed together under one Thorogood Americas in support of development of our business in the region. Further, we work with customers and colleagues in the US, UK, India, Singapore, and Brazil to provide effective solutions. The ability to work collaboratively and effectively as part of a distributed team is imperative. Our most successful consultants develop a well-rounded set of skills in each of these areas of business, people, and technology. You’ll do so via a number of opportunities: Comprehensive training:  During your first months at Thorogood, experienced consultants will introduce you to the technologies we work with, the industries we serve, and the ways in which we develop our business. Building your core technology skills:  We’re the kind of people who learn best by doing. You’ll be working on a team locked onto business value for the customer to develop fast, effective, and high-quality technical solutions. Working with top clients:  Thorogood works with some of the biggest and best-known companies in the world. You’ll be a part of client interactions, sometimes leading them, to make sure we’re keeping our projects on track and delivering value to our customers. Developing relationships:  We consider ourselves trusted advisors for our clients. We earn this trust through listening carefully, sharing the expertise we have acquired, and helping to progress the objectives within their organizations. Shaping future projects:  We are always listening to customers to understand their objectives and needs and working with our consultants to share proposals on how we can help. Working as part of a supportive project team:  When safe (with respect to the pandemic), you’ll be working from our offices, with occasional travel externally to client sites. Your project teams will comprise consultants across many levels of experience, working together daily to support one another along the way. Becoming an expert, yourself:  Our subject matter experts are not necessarily the most tenured people at Thorogood. In the rapidly changing world of data and analytics, we look to all levels of experience to gain expertise in new technologies and analytical techniques.  In addition to project work, Thorogood consultants run our company. We expect you to contribute here, as well: Helping to grow our business:  Interact with current and prospective clients, listen to their needs, and drive business development activities and discussions. Together, we’ll consider the business objectives in conjunction with the technical possibilities in order to understand the opportunities for their organizations. Delivering educationally focused marketing events:  Prepare and present informational events for contacts at prospective and current clients. Developing our consultancy:  Contribute to recruiting, training, and managing our people.  Additional Benefits We individually select each of our consultants very carefully through our comprehensive interview and assessment process. We place a great deal of value on consultants’ growth and wellbeing. In addition to a challenging and rewarding career path, Thorogood offers the following benefits: - Very competitive salary and compensation program - Company-sponsored health coverage - Incentive programs - Opportunities for national and international travel - Focus on work-life balance Location and Timing This position is based in our São Paulo office. Our consultants are currently working in a hybrid model and are expected to live and work in São Paulo-SP, Brazil. The expected start date for this position is January 2026 or July 2026, depending on candidate start date availability. About You Qualified candidates must  have Fluency in written and spoken English and Portuguese Strong interest in business, people, and technology Strong academic record in a related discipline, including engineering, computer science, mathematics, statistics, business, management, or another business and quantitative-focused field Bachelor’s or Mater's degree with graduation between November 2024 and June 2026.  Candidates must demonstrate effectiveness in Working individually and as part of project teams Maintaining responsibility and accountability for quality and work delivery Client focus and relationship management Time management and priority setting Data awareness and business interest Learning new technologies  - This is an entry-level position; no prior full-time employment experience is required. - Please do highlight if you have studied or worked with Cloud BI & Analytics technology platforms, e.g. Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform SQL, Python, R, Scala, Spark, or any other programming or statistical programming languages and frameworks Applied mathematics, statistics, probability, machine learning, or artificial intelligence Structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data storage, transformation, or analysis  How to Apply All stages of the recruitment process will be held in English.  Your application must  include both your résumé and a short video describing your interest and ability to succeed in this position, provided entirelyin English . Please submit your application bellow.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
description:
Empresa está contratando Engineering Manager, MAAS em espumoso. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Overview  Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.  We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team . Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We are hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.  The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service (MAAS) hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get Ubuntu on bare metal servers. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go. Its components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.  Canonical is seeking passionate technical leaders who are eager to drive innovation in one of Canonical's flagship data center products. You will play a key role in reshaping the future of data center technology through open source management platforms. MAAS aims to revolutionize data center management at scale starting from day zero deployment to long term data center expansion and maintenance.  Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence team and company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and guide strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.  The successful candidate will have technical leadership attributes and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.  Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.  What we are looking for in you   Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) and a background in Computer Science  Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university  Proven experience delivering software using Python, Golang, or similar languages  Experience with Linux system administration (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)  Familiarity with modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8S  Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems  Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills  Experience with agile software development methodologies  Ability to mentor, develop, and support team members  Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments  Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long    Nice-to-have skills   Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue  Data Center infrastructure management and design    What we offer colleagues  We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.   Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we\'ve been working remotely since 2004!  Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year  Annual compensation review  Recognition rewards  Annual holiday leave  Maternity and paternity leave  Employee Assistance Programme  Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues  Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events    About Canonical  Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.  Canonical is an equal opportunity employer  We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

A qualidade sempre foi prioridade, e é a razão pela qual adotamos uma norma internacional mundialmente reconhecida, a ISO 9001, para creditar nossos processos de atendimento com o que existe de mais criterioso em certificações.  Valores humanos e o rigor com o padrão de excelência elevou ao mais alto nível o nosso índice de recomendação entre os associados, gestores de Recursos Humanos e credenciados. Além do tempo médio de permanência nos planos médicos, que hoje está muito superior ao restante do mercado.  Tudo isso nós fazemos com um único propósito: oferecer o que existe de melhor no mundo da medicina para cuidar da sua saúde sempre de perto. description:

Consultor(a) de Processos Farmacotécnicos  A sua missão será:  Esta posição é parte do time de MSAT (Manufacturing Sciences and Technology) que é responsável por garantir a robustez de processos durante todo o ciclo de vida do produto da tecnologia de pastas. Você será responsável por avaliar dados de processo, prospectar e implementar melhorias de processos produtivos farmacêuticos, com os objetivos de reduzir perdas de processo, reduzir número de desvios, aumentar robustez e confiabilidade de processos, reduzir riscos industriais, regulatórios e recalls.  Papéis e Responsabilidades:    Liderará implementações de projetos de melhoria na fábrica de Paulínia na tecnologia de Semi-Sólidos/Pastas.  Liderará projetos de Scale Down/Quality By Design do produto semissólido/pastas.  Fará apresentações de reporte de andamento de projetos.  Trabalhará em conjunto com o time Global/Local para implementações de projetos em paralelo, garantindo a perenidade do produto semissólidos/pastas no site de PLN.  Definir QTTP, CQA e CMAs dos novos produtos desenvolvidos.  Coletar e analisar dados de processo (utilizando ferramentas estatísticas), desde a fase de definição.  Implementar os projetos definidos pela área de MSAT relacionados aos produtos semissólidos/pastas.  Prover avaliação técnica e estratégias de validação de processo para projetos de alteração de materiais e fornecedores.  Analisar dados históricos em caso de resolução de problemas e fornecer suporte proativo para aplicar projeto de experimentos, identificando riscos e melhorando a robustez ou produtividade do processo atual.  Reduzir riscos industriais, conduzir análises de riscos de processos, propondo melhorias de robustez, confiabilidade e segurança de processos.  Responder auditorias regulatórias tais como MAPA, FDA, ANSES.    Requeridos:    Graduação em Licenciatura em Farmácia, Engenharia Química, Engenharia de Alimentos, Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia de Materiais e áreas afins.  Experiência em Desenvolvimento de Semissólidos.  Forte conhecimento em processos industriais.  Forte experiência em manufatura/envase de produtos semissólidos/pastas.  Nível de inglês avançado.    Desejável:    Experiência em empresas regulamentadas por FDA, ANSES e MAPA.  Formação Green Belt ou Black Belt (diferencial).  Pós-Graduação em Gestão de Processos Industriais, Engenharia, Farmacêutica, Gestão de Projetos. title: Data & AI Consultant – Graduate – São Paulo, Brazil
description:
Empresa está contratando Data & AI Consultant – Graduate – São Paulo, Brazil em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Thorogood Thorogood is an independent, specialized, Data & AI consulting firm that works with some of the biggest and best-known companies around the world. We have offices in London, Philadelphia, Boston, Singapore, São Paulo, and Bangalore, and we work as a global unit to service blue chip customers drawing from data-rich sectors such as consumer goods, pharmaceuticals, insurance, and financial services sectors. Together, we compete on the basis of our specialism, our people, high quality, and assured delivery. We help our customers leverage the latest technologies to make timely, data-driven business decisions. Our multi-skilled teams understand the critical interplay of data engineering, data science, and data visualization. We work across these areas to create business-focused, end-to-end technology solutions robust enough to meet enterprise needs. We recognize the importance of environmental sustainability, both in how we work and in the solutions we build for our clients. Our services span strategy, implementation, advanced analytics services, user empowerment, and support. About the Position Overview Our team members are expected to have a strong interest in business. Understanding our clients’ organizations and industries is key to identifying areas of opportunity for us to help. Similarly, our people must have excellent listening, writing, and presenting skills, alongside the aptitude and motivation to master multiple data-focused technologies in a fast-moving field. This combination of business, people, and technical skills is essential. Our Brazil and US entities are managed together under one Thorogood Americas in support of development of our business in the region. Further, we work with colleagues across the US, UK, India, Singapore, and Brazil, and with global customers, to provide effective solutions. The ability to work collaboratively and effectively as part of a distributed team is imperative. Our most successful consultants develop a well-rounded set of skills in each of these areas of business, people, and technology. You’ll do so via a number of opportunities: Comprehensive training: During your first months at Thorogood, experienced consultants will introduce you to the technologies we work with, the industries we serve, and the ways in which we develop our business. Crucially, we will share how we live our values. When you’ve finished, we’ll plan to integrate you into both internal and client project initiatives. Building your core technology skills: We’re the kind of people who learn best by doing. You’ll be working on a team locked onto business value for the customer to develop fast, effective, and high-quality technical solutions. Working with top clients: Thorogood works with some of the biggest and best-known companies in the world. You’ll be a part of client interactions, sometimes leading them, to make sure we’re keeping our projects on track and delivering value to our customers. Developing relationships: We consider ourselves trusted advisors for our clients. We earn this trust through listening carefully, sharing the expertise we have acquired, and helping to progress the objectives within their organizations. Shaping future projects: We are always listening to customers to understand their objectives and needs and working with our consultants to share proposals on how we can help. Working as part of a supportive project team: You’ll be working from our offices, with occasional travel internally or externally to client sites. Your project teams will comprise consultants across many levels of experience, working together daily to support one another along the way. Becoming an expert, yourself: Our subject matter experts are not necessarily the most tenured people at Thorogood. In the rapidly changing world of Data & AI, we look to all levels of experience to gain expertise in new technologies and analytical techniques.  In addition to project work, Thorogood consultants run our company, thus it’s expected from them: Help to grow our business: Interact with current and prospective clients, listen to their needs, and drive business development activities and discussions. Together, we’ll consider the business objectives in conjunction with the technical possibilities in order to understand the opportunities for their organizations. Deliver educationally focused marketing events: Prepare and present informational events for contacts at prospective and current clients. Develop our consultancy: Contribute to recruiting, training, and managing our people.  Additional Benefits We individually select each of our consultants very carefully through our comprehensive interview and assessment process. We place a great deal of value on consultants’ growth and wellbeing. In addition to a challenging and rewarding career path, Thorogood offers the following benefits: Very competitive salary and compensation program Company-sponsored health coverage Incentive programs Opportunities for national and international travel Focus on work-life balance  Location and Timing This position is based in our São Paulo office. Our consultants are currently working in a hybrid model and are expected to work in São Paulo-SP, Brazil. The expected start date for this position is January 2026 or July 2026, depending on candidate start date availability. About You Qualified candidates must  have: Fluency  in written and spoken English and Portuguese Strong interest in business, people, and technology Strong academic record in a related discipline, including engineering, computer science, mathematics, statistics, business, management, or another business and quantitative-focused field Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with graduation between November 2024 and June 2026  Candidates must demonstrate effectiveness in: Working individually and as part of project teams Maintaining responsibility and accountability for quality and work delivery Client focus and relationship management Time management and priority setting Data awareness and business interest Learning new technologies  This is an entry-level position; no prior full-time employment experience is required . Please do highlight if you have studied or worked with: Cloud Data & AI technology platforms, e.g. Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform SQL, Python, R, Scala, Spark, or any other programming or statistical programming languages and frameworks Applied mathematics, statistics, probability, machine learning, or artificial intelligence Structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data storage, transformation, or analysis  How to Apply All stages of the recruitment process will be held in English. Your application must  include both your résumé and a short video describing your interest and ability to succeed in this position, provided entirely in English . Please submit your application here . To understand how we will handle the information you submit, please review our Job Applicants Privacy Policy. Please follow the link below to submit an application.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Arquiteto(a) de Dados | Especialista em Data Mesh & Governança
description:

Buscamos um(a) profissional experiente, com forte atuação consultiva e visão de arquitetura empresarial, para liderar a fase inicial de concepção, estruturação e orientação estratégica  do modelo de Data Mesh .  Este papel não envolve implementação técnica nesse primeiro momento. Trata-se de ser a referência interna , o porta-voz do tema  e o guia responsável por apoiar a organização nas decisões corretas antes de avançar para a execução. Conduzir a fase de entendimento, concepção e planejamento  do modelo Data Mesh, alinhando expectativas, premissas e objetivos de negócio.  Orientar a organização sobre o que deve ou não ser feito  em uma adoção madura de Data Mesh, trazendo visão crítica e prática baseada em experiências anteriores.  Apoiar na definição das capacidades organizacionais , papéis , responsabilidades , processos  e governança  necessárias para estruturar um modelo descentralizado.  Mapear riscos, dependências e requisitos antes do início da implementação técnica.  Oferecer recomendações de arquitetura, padrões e frameworks para suportar a jornada de Data Mesh.  Facilitar discussões entre áreas, aproximando times de negócio, tecnologia e dados.  Elaborar materiais executivos, guias e frameworks que suportem a tomada de decisão.  Acompanhar a evolução do roadmap, garantindo alinhamento estratégico entre stakeholders.    Requisitos obrigatórios    Experiência prática e comprovada com Data Mesh , incluindo concepção, implementação ou governança de domínios de dados.  Forte conhecimento em governança de dados , incluindo políticas, processos, operação e modelos organizacionais.  Experiência como Arquiteto(a) de Dados , Enterprise Architect, Data Strategist ou função equivalente.  Perfil altamente consultivo, com habilidade de traduzir conceitos complexos em direcionamentos claros para executivos e times técnicos.  Experiência com arquiteturas de dados em cloud  (AWS, Azure ou GCP).  Conhecimento sólido em Databricks , incluindo boas práticas, governança, modelo de uso e integração com ecossistemas de dados.  Vivência em ambientes corporativos que exigem integração entre áreas, descentralização e criação de capacidades organizacionais.  Conhecimento sólido de boas práticas de engenharia, qualidade, interoperabilidade e gestão de dados.    Diferenciais    Experiência com modelos operacionais de dados em larga escala (ex.: Data Mesh, Data Fabric, domínios de dados).  Histórico de atuação em projetos de transformação organizacional ou reestruturação de plataformas de dados.  Vivência em indústrias reguladas.  Capacidade de conduzir workshops, treinamentos e jornadas de evangelização técnica.    Soft Skills valorizadas    Comunicação clara e orientada à influência.  Visão sistêmica e estratégica.  Condução consultiva, com foco em resolução de problemas e tomada de decisão.  Liderança sem autoridade formal, com forte habilidade de articulação entre áreas.  Pensamento crítico e autonomia.    Nossos incentivos  ⭐   Auxílio médico : ajuda de custo mensal para apoiar na contratação do seu plano de saúde.  Wellhub , pra manter corpo e mente ativos, do jeito que você gosta.  Terapia online  100% custeada pela empresa, porque saúde mental importa.  Atendimento em Nutrição online , com até 2 consultas mensais para cuidar da sua saúde alimentar.  Seguro de vida  com apólice no valor de R$125 mil, garantindo mais segurança para você e sua família.  Day off no aniversário , porque o seu dia merece ser especial.  Descanso remunerado , para que você possa recarregar as energias.  Gamificação interna , transformando conquistas em prêmios e reconhecimento.  Parcerias educacionais com faculdades  como FIAP, Anhanguera e Instituto Infnet, pra apoiar seu crescimento e aprendizado.  Bônus por certificação técnica , reconhecendo e recompensando seu esforço em aprender.    Valorizamos cada voz e cada pessoa, porque sabemos que a diversidade nos torna mais inovadores e fortes.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Por isso, usamos a tecnologia para criar uma plataforma em nuvem, onde o empreendedor juntamente com o seu contador, de forma simples e fácil, podem encontrar tudo o que precisam em tempo real. Proposal Development & Deliverable Creation: Develop dynamic, visually compelling presentation decks and engagement proposals that articulate service offerings, project scope, value propositions, and strategic recommendations; Customize deliverables to reflect client-specific challenges uncovered during discovery; Integrate technical insights with business strategy to address immediate deliverables and long-term client growth.  Team Buildout & Project Kickoff: Act as the primary coordination point among Sales, Recruiting, and Engineering; ensure smooth handoffs from initial engagement through team buildout to project kickoff; serve as a concierge for deals and translate complex technical aspects into digestible, business-focused narratives; maintain a sales/consulting mindset to align proposals with targeted business outcomes.    Qualifications   Exceptional Communication & Soft Skills: outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly; strong presentation and storytelling abilities for clear client-facing communication.  UX & Presentation Design Acumen: solid grasp of user experience (UX) principles and design thinking; proven track record of creating high-quality, visually engaging presentation decks and proposals.  Technical Savvy & SDLC Knowledge: deep understanding of the software development lifecycle—from conceptualization through market release—and familiarity with agile methodologies; ability to discuss technical nuances without losing sight of business impact.  Analytical & Strategic Thinking: strong analytical skills to synthesize complex information, identify key insights, and recommend actionable strategies; ability to prioritize client objectives while balancing technical feasibility and business goals.  Team Collaboration & Cross-Functional Coordination: demonstrated ability to work across multiple departments, managing internal communications as deals move from funnel to kickoff; ability to serve as a liaison across Sales, Engineering, and Recruiting.  Consultative Sales Experience: prior experience in a pre-sales, sales engineering, or technical consulting role, ideally within a digital software consultancy or similar environment; ability to quickly assess client needs and translate them into actionable insights and proposals.  English: Upper Intermediate    Perks & Benefits   Professional growth: mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.  Competitive compensation: USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.  A selection of exciting projects: opportunities with Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.  Flextime: flexible schedule with options for remote work or office presence. Job Description  ✨A little about us  Get to know who we are and what drives our mission.   xChange is the world’s first online B2B marketplace to trade and lease shipping containers. We are a Series B startup with the ambition to become the world’s first and favorite place to buy containers, empowering local traders to seamlessly source and resell boxes while serving as the go-to sales channel for original equipment owners and wholesalers.  Our team of 50+ like-minded xChangees from a great variety of nationalities has made this possible! As a Sales Executive at Container xChange, you’ll engage in high-volume B2B container sales into the US market  and help scale our growth rapidly. You’ll manage the full sales cycle , build and own a portfolio of buyers , and play a key role in transforming container trading globally .  This is a highly transactional, full-cycle role  where you will grow your buyer portfolio while closing +300 deals per month . You will work with a qualified lead pool of roughly 15,000 potential buyers and convert both outbound and inbound demand into closed business.  You will run the entire sales cycle : prospecting, outbound calling, qualification, pricing, negotiation, and closing. Once buyers are activated, 70 to 80 percent of your revenue will come from repeat purchases, allowing you to scale your portfolio fast.  Selling into the US market requires strong English skills, speed, commercial judgment , and the ability to operate in a fragmented buyer landscape. Experience working with American customers is highly preferred.     Location  Where you'll be based and how we collaborate globally.   Our headquarters is located in the heart of Hamburg, Germany, with team members distributed across the globe. This is a hybrid position based in São Paulo, Brazil , where you’ll regularly collaborate in person with local colleagues to share ideas and drive customer success while having the flexibility to work from home as well. Since you’ll be targeting the U.S. market, U.S. time zone is required.  🚀 Your Impact  What you'll own, drive, and contribute to our success.   In this role, you will directly shape the future of container trading by helping us build the distribution channel for the entire industry  — giving buyers access to a unified global inventory, transparent price competition, and standardized fulfillment and guarantees. Your work will have a measurable impact on growth, customer experience, and market expansion.    Build and manage a portfolio of US buyers and close high volumes of container deals   Conduct high outbound activity  to find and convert demand, supported by a strong inbound engine  Work with fast sales cycles  and maintain momentum across hundreds of deals  Match customer needs with available inventory and negotiates pricing and margins effectively   Use AI powered sales tool stack  to maximize buyer experience and sales to track leads, monitor sales performance, and gain insights to continuously improve conversion rates      What Makes You a Great Fit?  The experience, skills, and mindset that will help you thrive.   We believe attitude beats years of experience. We’re looking for someone with a winning, competitive mindset  — someone who treats every deal as an opportunity, thrives under high volume , and brings the drive needed to succeed in a fast-paced, transactional sales environment .  You’re a great fit if you:   Have hands-on B2B sales experience  with strong outbound and cold-calling skills - ideally within a fast-paced transactional sales environment  Thrive in transactional sales  and can manage 300+ fast-cycle deals per month  Own the full sales cycle end to end  — from outbound prospecting and qualification to negotiation and closing  Are self-sufficient in pipeline generation , proactive in outbound activity, and confident converting warm leads from our strong inbound engine  Are comfortable selling to the US B2B market  and navigating a fragmented landscape of many smaller customers with frequent repeat purchases  Communicate clearly, negotiate confidently , and manage a large pipeline with discipline  Think entrepreneurial , act proactively, and stay organized and motivated while handling many fast-moving opportunities  Bring drive, resilience, and a success attitude  where every deal counts      What to Expect  Insights into perks, culture, and earning potential. Ownership & impact at xChange:  You will have a direct stake in xChange as a shareholder with a competitive virtual equity package! You will also have full ownership and trust to drive impactful topics, supported by smart and driven individuals. Plus, get personal coaching and counseling ...  Entrepreneurial freedom:  You run your own pipeline, own your deals, and can make immediate impact from day one.  xChange culture & collaboration:  Our diverse and talented team operates with flat hierarchies and a growth-focused mindset which fosters an open-minded, collaborative, and high-performance driven culture where A-players thrive.  AI Focus:  We believe AI is a game-changer for sales success. At xChange, you’ll get hands-on experience with AI tools designed to streamline sales operations, enhance your skills, and boost your conversion rates. This is a unique opportunity to grow alongside AI technologies that will empower you to work smarter and close more deals.  Other perks at xChange:  36 off days for remote employees outside of Germany, mental healthcare & coaching program, language courses and many more. title: DESENVOLVEDOR DE SISTEMAS EMBARCADOS
description:
Confira a vaga para DESENVOLVEDOR DE SISTEMAS EMBARCADOS em florianópolis. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Vaga presencial em Florianópolis | 44h semanais | Salário competitivo  Porque se juntar a nós  Dynamox é uma empresa de alta tecnologia que desenvolve soluções inteligentes de monitoramento de vibração, temperatura, corrente e tensão, ajudando equipes de manutenção e confiabilidade a tornarem a indústria mais segura, eficiente e sustentável.  Hoje, somos a única empresa mundial na área de manutenção com as certificações internacionais ISO 27001, 27701, 27017 e 27018, além da ISO 9001.  Além de processos bem estruturados, acreditamos em pessoas. Aqui, você encontra um ambiente organizado, colaborativo e orientado à melhoria contínua, onde o aprendizado é incentivado e excelência faz parte do dia a dia. Valorizamos quem busca evoluir, inovar e fazer a diferença.  Principais responsabilidades   Executar o desenvolvimento de sistemas embarcados;  Atuar na evolução e manutenção de produtos existentes;  Realizar a interface com as demais equipes do setor de desenvolvimento;  Executar testes funcionais, de validação, unitários e paramétricos;  Desenvolver documentação de projetos no Jira e nos recursos da plataforma Microsoft;  Conduzir a elaboração de documentos técnicos e com a pesquisa de inovações tecnológicas;  Dar suporte técnico, contribuindo com as demais equipes quando solicitado;  Contribuir e disseminar práticas de segurança de informação e privacidade de dados confidenciais e restritos, no que diz respeito às rotinas do departamento e empresa.    Requisitos   Programação em C/C++ para sistemas embarcados, atuando em ambientes bare metal ou com RTOS, incluindo desenvolvimento de drivers, controle de periféricos e depuração de baixo nível;  Conhecimento sobre protocolos e interfaces de comunicação embarcadas, como Modbus, CAN, SPI e RS-485, com experiência em integração de sensores, atuadores e dispositivos industriais;  Experiência em integração de dispositivos, otimização de uso de memória e processamento, gerenciamento de dados em tempo real e desenvolvimento com foco em operações de baixo consumo energético;  Aplicação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento para sistemas embarcados, incluindo arquitetura modular, abstração de hardware (HAL), uso de máquinas de estado, padrões de projeto e foco em adaptabilidade, testabilidade e manutenibilidade;  Garantia de qualidade e segurança do produto, incluindo implementação de medidas de segurança, integridade do firmware, realização de testes rigorosos, análise de riscos, identificação e mitigação de potenciais falhas, além de conformidade com normas e processos de QA;  Conhecimento sobre protocolos de rede aplicados a dispositivos conectados, como HTTP, TLS, DNS e NTP, considerando requisitos de segurança e confiabilidade;  Experiência com tecnologias de comunicação sem fio e conectividade embarcada, como Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Ethernet e redes móveis.    Diferenciais   Experiência com desenvolvimento de ferramentas e automação de processos utilizando linguagens como Python, C# ou C++, especialmente para testes, validação, integração contínua ou suporte ao desenvolvimento embarcado;  Conhecimento em integração com bancos de dados e serviços em nuvem, como SQL, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, S3 ou similares, no contexto de soluções IoT e telemetria;  Familiaridade com protocolos industriais adicionais, como OPC, e integração com sistemas de supervisão ou plataformas industriais.    Formação   Ensino médio concluído, sendo desejável curso técnico em mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas;  Ensino superior em andamento ou concluído em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia de Produção ou em áreas correlatas.    Benefícios   Transporte : Vale transporte ou auxílio deslocamento sem desconto em folha  Cartão multi-benefícios : Um cartão flexível, facilitando o uso do vale alimentação/refeição flexível, onde você escolhe como e onde utilizar  Seguro de vida : Seguro de vida global  Plano de Saúde e odontológico : Plano de saúde e odontológico custeado pela empresa após o período de experiência  Convênio SESI : Convênios com Farmasesi e OdontoSesi para garantir seu bem-estar  Saúde e bem-estar : Convênio GoGood, que oferece descontos em academias e atendimento com nutricionistas, psicólogos e outros profissionais de saúde  Cuidados com a ergonomia : Atendimento com fisioterapeuta/osteopata na empresa  Desenvolvimento profissional : Incentivos ao seu desenvolvimento, formações e programas de incentivo a certificações  Incentivos : PLR, gratificação por desempenho e formações  Parcerias : EBAC e Influx  Reconhecimento : Gratificação por tempo de casa conclusão de curso  Conforto e alimentação no escritório : Frutas e café à vontade, além de acesso ao Market4u e Dynamarket  Cultura e clima : Confraternização mensal e ambiente descontraído, sem dress code  Localização : Escritório com uma vista incrível! Estamos situados ao lado do Parque Tecnológico de Florianópolis, no bairro Itacorubi.    VAGA 100% PRESENCIAL - VAGA DISPONÍVEL PARA CANDIDATURA DE PCD - CLT - 44h   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Software Engineer, Backend (All teams) – Brazil – Vaga para mulheres
description:
Nova oportunidade para Software Engineer, Backend (All teams) – Brazil – Vaga para mulheres em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Software Engineer, Backend (All teams) – Brazil – Vaga para mulheres  Engineering the future of logistics – from Brazil to the world  This role is part of our commitment to increase the representation of women in technology at DoorDash Brazil. We strongly encourage candidates who identify as women to apply.  We are building an engineering team where women have equitable access to opportunity, leadership, and long-term career growth within our São Paulo hub.  At DoorDash, we believe diverse teams build better products. This opportunity is designed to create greater equity in access to engineering roles and long-term career growth within our São Paulo engineering hub.  DoorDash is building the world’s most reliable on-demand logistics platform. As part of our global expansion, we are investing heavily in Brazil and growing our engineering presence in São Paulo. This is a unique opportunity to join one of Silicon Valley’s fastest-growing companies—while staying close to home.  We’re looking for Backend Engineers who are excited to solve real-world problems at scale. You’ll work on product teams or platform teams that power our three-sided marketplace of Consumers, Dashers, and Merchants . From improving restaurant discovery to optimizing delivery logistics, you’ll help shape the experience of millions of users.  You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and designers—many based in the U.S.—so fluency in English and strong collaboration skills are essential.  What you’ll do   Design, build, and maintain large-scale backend systems used by millions of users  Contribute to our technical roadmap and define the architecture for key product areas  Drive improvements in performance, scalability, reliability, and security  Help transition parts of our monolithic codebase to a microservices architecture  Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Brazil and the U.S.  Work on high-impact features that directly improve the user experience for Dashers, Merchants, or Consumers    We’re excited about you because…   You have 1+ years of experience with backend technologies and distributed systems  You’re comfortable with modern web architecture (HTTP, REST APIs, grpc, microservices)  You’ve worked with relational and non-relational databases  You enjoy solving complex problems with elegant code and clear thinking  You’re fluent in English and confident participating in meetings and code reviews in English  You care about quality and write tests to ensure your code works as expected  You take ownership and enjoy working with autonomy in a fast-paced environment    Nice to haves   Experience working at a tech company with scale  Familiarity with Java, Kotlin, or similar JVM languages  Exposure to big data technologies or event-driven architecture  Interest in mentorship or growing into a technical leadership role    Why join DoorDash Brazil?   Work on a global product, with real impact on millions of people  Be part of a fast-growing engineering hub in São Paulo  Hybrid remote model with great office space in Av. Paulista  English immersion and opportunities to grow your international career  Contribute to a modern, scalable platform used across multiple countries  Build the future of local commerce with a team that values ownership, humility, and getting 1% better every day  Be part of a growing engineering organization committed to building inclusive teams and equitable opportunities    About DoorDash  At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We\'re committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.  Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion  We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.  This position is open to candidates with disabilities. DoorDash welcomes applicants registered with the national autism registry (SisTEA) and others who seek an inclusive workplace. If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.    #J-18808-Ljbffr
