title: Senior Manager, Financial Partnerships, Local Payment Methods
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior Manager, Financial Partnerships, Local Payment Methods em região geográfica intermediária de são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Airwallex  Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 200,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Rippling, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.  Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,000 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 26 offices around the globe. Valued at US$8 billion and backed by world‑leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.  Attributes We Value  We hire successful builders with founder‑like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role‑related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.  You’re humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end‑to‑end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.  About The Team  The Financial Partnerships team at Airwallex is dedicated to building and managing strategic relationships with key financial institutions and partners worldwide. We work to expand Airwallex’s network, enhance our product offerings, and drive mutual growth. By fostering strong collaborations, we ensure our customers have access to the best financial solutions and services. Our team is committed to delivering value through innovative and seamless partnerships.  What You’ll Do  We're looking for a Senior Manager, Financial Partnerships, to be based in São Paulo, Brazil to own our key strategic relationships related to our banking infrastructure across the US and the Americas.  The ideal candidate is a self‑starter and ‘out‑of‑the‑box’ thinker who has worked in the payments and/or financial services industry. Experience building and maintaining relationships with financial institutions in the US and the Americas whilst working at a payment institution/EMI is essential for this role. You must have a strong network of banking partners, card schemes, and payment networks to help Airwallex scale.  Please submit resumes in English.  Responsibilities   Lead, develop, and implement a banking partnerships strategy for the US and the Americas that supports our vision for Airwallex’s global collections and payouts network.  Manage our most strategic partnership opportunities, both existing and new, and act as the main point of contact between Airwallex and our partners.  Conduct market research to understand the competitive landscape to ensure that Airwallex maintains its position as a payment leader.  Identify and evaluate opportunities to integrate with local banking partners, acquirers, and payment methods as Airwallex expands to new geographies.  Coordinate due diligence processes with prospective partners and project manage onboarding with new partners.  Develop yourself as an industry thought leader.    Who You Are  We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.  Minimum Qualifications   7+ years of experience working with financial institutions, card schemes, and payment networks.  Exceptional attention to detail and ability to build and maintain relationships. A good understanding of compliance and onboarding with global and regional banks.  Experience working with cross‑functional teams including Product, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Commercial teams.  International experience – working in multiple markets or managing cross‑border relationships.  A proven track record of working with technology‑led businesses in a dynamic, fast‑paced environment.  You are an exceptional communicator – you’re able to connect with people at all levels, both internally and externally, and communicate project expectations effectively.  You thrive under pressure – and work well with constant change and the ambiguity of a startup environment.  You have strong negotiation skills – to navigate complex commercial discussions to ensure the best outcome for Airwallex.  You’re a team player – work cohesively with colleagues from across the organization and be able to inspire a shared vision.    Preferred Qualifications   Proven experience at a global, pre‑IPO startup  Experience building a financial partnerships function in a new geography  Experience with Fintech thought leadership    Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third‑Party Recruiters  To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. **Job Description:****Nextpower – Structural Engineer I****Location**: Sorocaba, Brazil**Reporting**: Director of Civil - Geotechnical Engineering**Work Type:** Hybrid - 4 days in office, 1 day remote**Language Proficiency**: Fluent in English (C1/C2 level required)Nextpower is the leading provider of intelligent, integrated solar tracker and software solutions used in utility-scale and ground-mounted distributed generation solar projects around the world. Nextpower has been the number one global market-share solar tracker company with an average market share of 30% for seven years and counting, according to global research firms Wood Mackenzie and IHS Markit.Nextpower pioneered smart solar tracking technology and continues to lead the industry with our design, engineering and software innovation. Our robust portfolio of intellectual property protects both our hardware and software products, and includes 132 mechanical patents, 52 electronics & controls patents, and 171 software-driven yield improvement patents.At Nextpower, we are on a mission to be the most trusted and valued renewable energy company by delivering intelligent, reliable, and productive solar power. We are a diverse group of technology innovators and clean energy activators. We are collaborative team players, accountable and deliver results. We are committed to sustainability, decarbonization and a better tomorrow.**About the Role**Nextpower is seeking a **Structural Engineer I** to join our **Project Engineering Team** , supporting key accounts across the **U.S and North America markets.** This position will be responsible for managing day-to-day structural engineering tasks for foundations of utility-scale PV projects from the development phase through construction.Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, wind load calculations, steel design, component sizing, foundation sizing, structural tool development and the preparation of structural documentation to support project quoting and engineering packages. The role will involve close coordination with cross-functional teams in the U.S., India, and other global offices including Sales, Project Management, and R&D.**Key Responsibilities*** Produce civil and structural design documentation, including drawings and calculations.* Support the project development phase by reviewing site information, performing calculations, and contributing to cost estimations.* Perform structural analyses for wind, seismic, and foundation loads, and prepare corresponding calculations and reports; sign/seal documents if required.* Provide construction phase support by responding to RFIs and reviewing submittals.* Develop a comprehensive understanding of Nextpower products to support engineering decisions.* Collaborate with structural/Geotechnical/civil engineers across regions to maintain and update standards, specifications, templates, and design tools.* Manage schedules and review deliverables from structural and Foundation engineering consultants.* Support the ongoing development and expansion of Nextpower’s Design Services team.* Occasional sites visit to supervise Geotech investigations, foundation installation and pile load testing.* **Required Skills/ Expertise:**  + BS in Structural Engineering with emphasis on Foundations. MS in Structural Engineering is a plus.  + Strong knowledge of international engineering standards, codes, and other applicable state and federal guidelines, including but not limited to IBC, ASCE, ASTM, AISC, and ACI.  + Proficiency in finite element analysis software (RISA, STAAD, or equivalent)  + Proficiency in advanced modal and dynamic analysis  + Minimum of 2 years of structural engineering experience, preferably in the solar EPC industry.  + Demonstrated experience in structural design, including dead, live, snow, wind, and seismic loads, as well as steel structure design and construction documentation.  + Proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel), AutoCAD,  + Proficiency in foundation tools like LPILE/AllPile, Risa foundation, Staad foundations, Plaxis and other structural analysis tools.  + Proficiency in programming languages is a plus.  + Self-motivated team player with strong communication and collaboration skills.  + Passion for renewable energy and solar power is a plus.  + Fluent English is required to communicate effectively with clients, manage international projects, and produce high-quality technical documentation.At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.# **We are Nextpower**#J-18808-Ljbffr

Analisar relatórios de discrepâncias e implementar soluções para garantir a precisão das informações;  •  Coordenação de Lançamentos e Contratos: Gerenciar o lançamento de dados financeiros e operacionais relacionados aos benefícios, incluindo rateio de faturas, lançamentos em sistemas financeiros e controle de custos. Efetuar a gestão dos contratos com fornecedores de benefícios, assegurando a melhor qualidade e custo-benefício;  •  Análise de Custos e Planejamento Orçamentário: Controlar e analisar os custos mensais de benefícios, mantendo planilhas atualizadas com os valores, períodos e referências, a fim de fornecer suporte para a elaboração do orçamento e controle financeiro da área. Apoiar na criação de relatórios de indicadores e performance para a alta gestão;  •  Acompanhamento de Inclusão/Exclusão de Benefícios: Supervisionar o processo de inclusão e exclusão de colaboradores nos benefícios de saúde, odontológico, seguro de vida, vale alimentação, vale transporte e outros, assegurando que todos os colaboradores elegíveis sejam devidamente cadastrados e os procedimentos sejam realizados conforme as políticas e prazos;  •  Gestão de Reajustes e Contratos de Benefícios: Acompanhar as renovações e reajustes dos contratos de benefícios, garantindo que as alterações sejam aplicadas corretamente, com a devida comunicação e transparência para os colaboradores. Prestar suporte técnico e operacional para o time de Recursos Humanos e outras áreas que necessitem de orientação sobre a gestão de benefícios. Temos presença aeroespacial  (com 5 satélites em órbita pela Embratel) e somos referência em conectividade industrial, automotiva, agronegócio  e outros. Também temos um ambiente de conexão entre nossos negócios e o ecossistema de inovação, que é o beOn , o hub de inovação da Claro e Embratel. Sustentabilidade  é um valor para a Claro. Investimos no desenvolvimento ambiental, economico e social, prezando sempre pela governança, responsabilidade ambiental, proteção de dados e impacto social. Por meio do Instituto Claro , conectamos pessoas para um futuro melhor, aliando os serviços prestados a investimentos sociais em projetos de educação e cidadania.  E aí, deu match? Gestão completa dos produtos de Dados avançado: Internet dedicada BLD e Responsável pela gestão completa dos produtos de Dados avançado , desde a concepção da ideia até o lançamento, performance financeira e estratégia de mercado. Este profissional será uma peça-chave no desenvolvimento e evolução de produtos, garantindo alinhamento entre tecnologia, negócio e experiência do cliente. Gestão do Ciclo de Vida do Produto  Desenvolver, lançar, evoluir e descontinuar os produtos conforme as necessidades do mercado e da empresa. Garantir que os produtos estejam sempre atualizados, competitivos e aderentes à estratégia da Claro Empresas.  Pesquisa e Benchmark de Mercado  Monitorar tendências, concorrentes e novas tecnologias. Conduzir pesquisas de mercado, benchmark e análise de concorrência para identificar oportunidades e tendências. Identificar oportunidades de novos produtos ou melhorias em soluções existentes, com foco em PMEs. Buscar e negociar com parceiros estratégicos. Avaliar viabilidade técnica, comercial e operacional das parcerias. Desenvolver business cases para novos produtos e iniciativas, validando viabilidade técnica, comercial e financeira.  Roadmap e Planejamento Estratégico  Definir visão, estratégia e roadmap dos produtos. Estabelecer metas de crescimento, penetração e receita para cada solução. Trabalhar em conjunto com Marketing, Vendas, Canais, Tecnologia, Jurídico e Atendimento para garantir o sucesso do produto. Garantir o alinhamento com as diretrizes da Claro e a jornada do cliente. Precificação e Modelo de Receita  Definir preços competitivos e políticas de desconto com base em benchmarks e estrutura de custo.  Go-to-Market e Lançamentos  Planejar e coordenar o lançamento de produtos: materiais, treinamentos, campanhas e argumentação comercial. Garantir a execução da estratégia de GTM (Go-to-Market), em conjunto com times comercial, canais e comunicação. Suportar os times de vendas com conteúdo e diferenciais do produto. Monitorar métricas de uso, receita, churn e NPS. Monitorar KPIs de performance, churn, receita, margem e adotar ações corretivas quando necessário. Propor ações corretivas ou de aceleração com base em dados e feedback dos clientes. Gerenciar o P&L dos produtos, atuando proativamente na rentabilidade e expansão do portfólio. Entender profundamente as dores e necessidades dos clientes (PMEs). Realizar entrevistas, pesquisas e testes de usabilidade. Fomentar a inovação contínua com foco na experiência do cliente, eficiência operacional e diferenciação de mercado. Influenciar stakeholders internos e externos, assegurando alinhamento e execução eficaz da estratégia do produto.  O que esperamos de você? Quer aprender sempre mais, propõe novas soluções e questiona o status quo; Resiliência: capacidade de lidar com as adversidades e tornar as dificuldades aprendizados para futuras ações; Atitude, Ambição e Inconformismo: não se limita ao básico, quer algo mais e oferece além. Tem iniciativa para se antecipar a demanda e a necessidade do cliente; Relacionamento com Cliente/Empatia Digital: vê o cliente como sua prioridade, traduz a necessidade do cliente pensando na melhor solução para atendê-lo mantendo a visão de dono. Vivência com P&L, GTM, desenho de produto e atuação em squads multidisciplinares. Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Produtos, Marketing ou áreas afins; Inglês e espanhol intermediário/avançado; Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e ferramentas como Jira, Confluence; Conhecimento em SQL para análise de dados e extração de insights.  E por que a escolher a Claro?  Na Claro, pessoas é um dos nossos valores. Com este pensamento, investimos sempre no cuidado com a saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida dos nossos colaboradores! Para que você tenha a melhor experiência em sua jornada com a gente, oferecemos um atraente pacote de benefícios. Veja só: . Assistência Médica . Assistência Odontológica . Auxílio para patologias graves · Vale-Refeição e Alimentação · Auxílio ao Dependente com Deficiência · Previdência Privada . Seguro saúde - Pets . Acompanhar o processo de rotulagem de produtos, por meio da revisão técnica, conferência, adequação legal e aprovação de rótulos. Controlar cadastros e licenças institucionais nas três esferas governamentais, conduzindo solicitações, renovações e atualizações documentais perante órgãos ambientais, sanitários e reguladores, incluindo também a gestão de filiais (abertura, alteração, atualização cadastral e encerramento quando aplicável). Pós-graduação será considerada um diferencial.  Experiência comprovada na área regulatória.  Conhecimento desejável de inglês e espanhol.  Domínio sólido do pacote Office (Excel, PowerPoint).  Será considerado diferencial conhecimento em sistemas como SAP, SAP Concur e Power BI.  Perfil analítico, organizado, com boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar com múltiplas demandas e prazos.     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Sourcing Manager (Logistic e Wharehouse) / CS / São Paulo,SP
description:
Empresa está contratando Sourcing Manager (Logistic e Wharehouse) / CS / São Paulo,SP em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Sourcing Manager (Logistic e Wharehouse) / CS / São Paulo,SP  — Bayer   Mission  – Health for all, Hunger for none – is at the heart of everything we do. Imagine a workplace where your voice truly matters, where leaders are mentors, and innovation cycles are quick as 90 days. With Dynamic Shared Ownership (DSO), we’re building an agile, less bureaucratic organization focused on creating real value for farmers, patients, consumers, employees, investors, and society. Diversity and Inclusion are core values that spark creativity and innovation. If you want to shape your own path, value creativity and innovation, you’ll feel at home here.  Your Mission    Sourcing: Lead all sourcing activities with external suppliers, communicate supply constraints, and support strategic initiatives with Procurement Category Leads.  Supplier Management: Manage supplier relationships, create robust supply agreements, and leverage market intelligence to mitigate risks and drive competitive advantage.  Stakeholder Engagement: Engage with internal stakeholders to understand needs, set joint targets, and provide procurement expertise.    Key Benefits of Joining    Be part of a new team in Procurement focused on Sourcing capability – learn the profession from scratch.  Make global connections that feel local – multicultural teams in flexible work setups.  Enjoy purpose with autonomy – empowered to act, shape decisions, and take ownership in DSO.  Experience a culture that values curiosity and collaboration – learn, grow, experiment, and have fun.    Must Have    Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in science, engineering or business management.  Experience: Relevant experience in procurement operations or supply chain management with a focus on strategic sourcing.  Technical Skills: Experience in procurement systems (e.g., Ariba) and Microsoft Office Suite.  Languages: Excellent proficiency in English and Portuguese.  Live in São Paulo, SP and availability to go to the office 3 times per week.    Nice to Have    Spanish language proficiency.    What else you’ll find here    Encouragement for a healthy lifestyle.  Support in identifying and monitoring physical and mental health risks.  Initiatives focused on health promotion, prevention, and care.  Real balance between personal and professional life.  Guidance for personal financial planning.  Insurance and private pension plans to build a secure future.    Additional Benefits    Flexible/hybrid work model.  Short Fridays and extended holiday breaks.  Flexible vacation planning within legal guidelines.  Language courses – free access to standard courses via Education First (EF).  Pharmacy subsidy – 50% discount on Bayer over-the-counter products, full coverage for prescription Bayer medications.  Conte Comigo – support program offering psychological, substance dependency, legal and financial counseling.  Bem Nascer – exclusive package for new parents.  Childcare assistance for parents welcoming a new child.  Parental leave – equal opportunities for all parents.  Private pension plan – 200% company match on contributions.    Job Details    Seniority level: Entry level  Employment type: Full-time  Job function: Purchasing and Supply Chain  Industries: Chemical Manufacturing, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, and Biotechnology Research  Location: São Paulo, SP, Brazil  Reference:      Application Period  – 08/12/25 to 19/12/25   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Sr consultant sap plant maintenance
description:
Empresa está contratando Sr consultant sap plant maintenance em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Role Overview  We are seeking a highly experienced Senior SAP PM Consultant to support a strategic divestiture programme in Brazil. The consultant will lead the separation and reconfiguration of SAP Plant Maintenance processes, ensuring operational continuity and compliance with Brazilian localisation standards. This role demands deep functional expertise in SAP PM, strong integration capabilities, and hands-on experience with maintenance planning and execution.  Key Responsibilities   Lead SAP PM implementation and configuration for divestiture-specific maintenance operations.  Conduct As-Is and To-Be analysis, and prepare Business Blueprints for PM processes.  Configure and customise maintenance plants, work centres, task lists, measuring points, counters, and maintenance plans.  Implement and support breakdown, corrective, preventive (time and performance-based), refurbishment, calibration, and external service management processes.  Manage master data including materials, assemblies, serial numbers, BOMs, and equipment hierarchies.  Ensure integration with SAP PP, MM, CO, and QM modules.  Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless transition and system integrity.  Support data migration, cutover planning, and post-go-live hypercare.  Conduct UAT, troubleshoot issues, and ensure defect-free deployments.  Document functional specifications, process flows, and training materials.  Provide regular updates to stakeholders and coordinate with business analysts and project managers.    Requisitos  Required Qualifications:    Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.  Minimum 7-10 Years Of Hands-on Experience In SAP PM.   Proven experience in divestiture, carve-out, or M&A projects.  Strong understanding of Brazilian localisation and regulatory compliance.  Experience with SAP ECC and S/4HANA platforms.  Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.  Fluency in Portuguese and English.    Preferred Qualifications   SAP PM certification.  Experience with SAP EAM, EH&S, and integration with IoT platforms.  Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools (Jira, Confluence).  Experience in global rollouts and multi-country implementations. E como é ser uma #PessoaPitangueira?  Acreditamos que as pessoas são o aspecto mais importante no que fazemos no dia a dia. Aqui, criamos um ambiente acolhedor, colaborativo e ético. Queremos que cada pessoa se sinta à vontade para ser exatamente quem é! #BeYourself "Criamos sistemas, automatizamos processos, mas somos pessoas!" Fundada em 2004, a Pitang é fruto de um spinoff da área de projetos comerciais do C.E.S.A.R, um dos principais institutos de inovação do país, e desenvolve serviços e soluções de alta qualidade em Tecnologia de Informação e Comunicação, focando nas demandas do mercado de uma forma inovadora, através do desenvolvimento de projetos exclusivos que suportam a transformação digital de seus clientes utilizando competências em Computação Cognitiva, Plataformas de Experiências Digitais, Analytics, Computação em Nuvem, Aplicativos Móveis, UX, Agilidade, DevOps e Testes. Perfil que Buscamos   Extremamente curioso sobre IA: Você está sempre explorando as últimas tendências e ferramentas.  Proativo e autodidata: Já testa ferramentas por conta própria e tem um portfólio de experimentos.  Ágil e adaptável: Gosta de aprender rápido, não tem medo de errar e itera com velocidade.  Detalhes e refinamento: Tem paciência para ajustes finos e um olhar crítico para o refinamento visual.    Conhecimentos Técnicos Essenciais   Inglês Avançado: Leitura, escrita e conversação fluentes são fundamentais para acompanhar as inovações e interagir com a comunidade global de IA.  Inteligência Artificial (Prática Obrigatória):  Engenharia de Prompts: Habilidade para criar e refinar prompts para obter os resultados desejados.  Prompts Avançados para Vídeo e Imagem: Conhecimento para ajustes de estilo, cenário, iluminação, ritmo e expressões.  Ferramentas de IA para Imagem: Experiência com ferramentas como Gemini, Midjourney, ou outras para a criação e variação de visuais.  Voz com IA: Experiência com clonagem e uso de voz com ElevenLabs ou similares, com foco em ajuste de entonação, pausas e naturalidade.  Capacidade de Teste e Evolução: Mais importante que dominar uma única ferramenta, é saber testar, comparar resultados e evoluir prompts.      Edição de Vídeo:  CapCut: Proficiência na ferramenta é essencial.  Edição com IA: Conhecimento de ferramentas de edição que utilizam IA.  Técnicas de Edição: Corte e montagem manual, sincronização de áudio, ajustes de ritmo e lipsync.        Desejáveis   Ferramentas de IA para Vídeo: Experiência com ferramentas emergentes como Veo, Sora, entre outras, é um grande diferencial.  Noções de Narrativa e Estética:  Enquadramento e ritmo narrativo.  Continuidade visual e acabamento para vídeo final.        Principais Responsabilidades   Criação de Vídeos com IA: A partir de vídeos base, áudios ou roteiros fornecidos pelo time.  Desenvolvimento e Teste de Prompts: Criar prompts avançados para variação de cenário, narrativa e diferentes versões de copy.  Edição e Finalização: Realizar cortes, sincronização de áudio, ajustes visuais e refinamento de lipsync.  Pesquisa e Inovação: Testar novas ferramentas e atualizações no campo da IA para vídeo.Documentação: Registrar aprendizados, melhores práticas, e o que funciona ou não.  Organização: Manter arquivos, versões e a biblioteca de conteúdos organizados.    Diferenciais   Já ter criado vídeos com avatares ou pessoas geradas por IA.  Noções básicas de design ou composição visual.    Se você é um entusiasta de IA com um olhar criativo e técnico, e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que está moldando o futuro do conteúdo em vídeo, queremos conhecer você!   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Garantir que todas as parcerias estejam alinhadas à visão, valores e público‑alvo da Elite Clinic. Integração Estratégica   Trabalhar em conjunto com o marketing , acompanhando a performance das campanhas e qualidade dos leads.  Participar das definições de metas comerciais e campanhas sazonais  com a diretoria médica.  Garantir a integração entre recepção, enfermagem e equipe médica , evitando falhas na jornada do paciente.  Auxiliar na criação de campanhas internas e externas  para aumento de vendas e engajamento.    5. Pós‑venda e Fidelização   Supervisionar o acompanhamento pós‑consulta  e garantir a continuidade dos pacientes ativos.  Criar ações de fidelização e indicação  (NPS, Google Review, programas de vantagens, vouchers e experiências). Conhecimento em CRM (Kommo, RD Station, Pipedrive ou similares).  Habilidade com planilhas, metas e apresentações de resultado.  Vivência com gestão de parcerias, eventos e relacionamento B2B.     RELACIONAMENTO HIERÁRQUICO   Reporta‑se diretamente à:  Diretoria  Supervisiona:  Comercial 1, Comercial 2, Sucesso do Cliente, Pós‑venda e Recepção    OBJETIVO FINAL  Garantir o crescimento contínuo da Elite Clinic, fortalecendo a marca através de resultados comerciais sólidos, relacionamentos estratégicos e uma experiência memorável para o paciente.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

About The Role  We are hiring an Associate Director, Design—a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in both managing creative talent and driving high-quality design execution across various platforms. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.  You will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.  This role requires a balance of leadership and creativity in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment, where you’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Management Responsibilities   Manage a team of designers, starting with 2–4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.  Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.  Ensure high‑quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.  Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.  Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.    Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities   Lead 1–2 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e‑commerce websites.  Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.  Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.  Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.  Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.    You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You   3–6+ years of senior‑level design experience, with at least 1 year of people‑management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.  Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.  Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.  Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.  Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.  Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.  Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.  Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.  Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.  Bonus: Experience in e‑commerce or hospitality website design, familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.    Working at Darkroom  Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.  We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.   Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in‑office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.  Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.  Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.    Equal Opportunity Statement  Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We design and develop robust systems that handle large volumes of real-time and historical data from industrial assets. Develop and maintain APIs and services that power both real-time monitoring features and complex maintenance workflows. Optimize applications and data processing workflows for performance, focusing on enhancing speed, efficiency, and reliability across various operating environments Continuously evolve our systems through refactoring, introducing best practices, and improving maintainability and observability. Strong programming skills in Go, Python, Node.js, and/or Rust Deep understanding of microservices architecture and distributed system design.
